newsitem.title: UK: African leaders to hold conference in London.
newsitem.headline: African leaders to hold conference in London.

text.p: African leaders will gather in London for an international conference in October to mark the 40th anniversary of the beginning of decolonisation of the continent.
The conference, "Africa at 40", will be held from October 27-29 following the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting in Edinburgh.
South African President Nelson Mandela and President Jerry Rawlings of Ghana have been invited to make keynote speeches and singer Miriam Makeba will be the star guest.

Pegged to coincide with the 40th anniversary of Ghana's independence which is regarded as the start of an independent Africa, the conference will cover the progress of the continent over the last four decades, its current social and economic conditions and its future. REUTER
